column1: # What the delivered art does not satisfy today.
# tools/model-validate.py fails on a violation that is NOT listed here, so
# this is a ratchet: fix a model and drop its row in the same commit, and the
# gain is locked in. Regenerate with: tools/model-validate.py --refresh
# Most rows are pivot conventions, and several are correct as they stand — a
# Leaper mid-jump is airborne, a broken Barricade sags, a wall socket hangs
# off a wall. A row for a *contract* check is different: that is a real defect
# someone chose to carry, so give it a reason and a way out. Those are
# restated on every run rather than passing quietly.

counted as 0 because the mesh still carries userData.gizmo — triCount and countMeshes in tower-kit.js skip gizmo meshes, and bakeSkies() only clears the flag on a sky it re-bakes. This one ships a pre-baked MeshBasicMaterial, so it never goes through bakeSkies and keeps the flag, while the exporter writes the mesh normally. The other three skyboxes agree with their rows exactly. Fix upstream: clear gizmo on the toaster sky in toaster.js, or have the stat helpers not skip a mesh that is actually exported.
